tools.name: search_registrations
tools.description: Search controlled substance registrations by prescriber name, registration type, or location. Returns matching records with expiry date and status.

tools.name: list_cannot_prescribe
tools.description: List prescribers whose DEA registration or state controlled substance license has expired — the practitioners who cannot legally write controlled prescriptions right now.

tools.name: get_registrations_expiring
tools.description: List controlled substance registrations expiring within the next N days (default 90), including state CSRs and mid-level registrations.

tools.name: get_authority_summary
tools.description: Get the controlled substance authority summary: totals for tracked registrations, renewals not started, expired, due in 30 days, and awaiting issue.

tools.name: export_registration_report
tools.description: Export the full controlled substance registration report as CSV text (prescriber, registration, expiry, status, reminder history).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_cannot_prescribe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List prescribers whose DEA registration or state controlled substance licence has expired — the practitioners who cannot legally write controlled prescriptions right now." → after: "List prescribers whose DEA registration or state controlled substance license has expired — the practitioners who cannot legally write controlled prescriptions right now."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
